description: Debt ledger for transitional sorry/axiom blocks. Each entry must be amortized with a deadline, governor, and pairing strategy.

entries.name: kappaExp_close_to_exp
entries.description: Float.abs (kappaExp 0.01 1.0 - exp 1.0) < 0.1. The closed-literal claim is NOT kernel-reducible in Lean 4 core (Float.exp/Float.pow are opaque, no Mathlib dep), so neither decide nor rfl can close it. Runtime value confirmed: |2.718237 - 2.718282| = 4.5e-05 < 0.1 (verified by `#eval`), so the statement is true; a kernel proof requires transcendental float semantics compatible with the kernel's reduction.
entries.resolution: Introduce a rational/real-arithmetic approximation semantics for kappaExp (ADR-114) or add Mathlib Float transcendental lemmas; then replace this sorry with a kernel proof. Runtime check (not kernel): #eval Float.abs (kappaExp 0.01 1.0 - Float.exp 1.0) = 4.5e-05.

entries.name: kappaLog_one_always_zero
entries.description: forall k, kappaLog k 1.0 = 0.0. Needs symbolic Float.pow 1.0 x = 1.0 (absent in core Lean). Intended domain: finite (non-NaN) k, k where pow 1.0 k is 1.0. Instance-level kernel witnesses are unavailable (Float.pow opaque).
entries.resolution: Prove over a rational surrogate u = Float.pow 1.0 x via a Float.pow_one lemma added in a Mathlib-based backend; then drop the universal claim or restrict the domain.

entries.name: relaxation_positive
entries.description: forall gamma mu, gamma > mu -> mu >= 0 -> relaxationTimePrediction gamma mu > 0. Requires symbolic Float ordering/division/reciprocation lemmas absent from core Lean. A concrete kernel witness exists: Stability.relaxation_time_finite_witness (relaxationTimePrediction 1.0 0.5 > 0, decide-proved).
entries.resolution: Add Float one-division-monotone lemmas (or Mathlib) and prove with h_gamma/h_strong under a Float preorder section.

entries.name: kappaExp_zero
entries.description: forall k, kappaExp k 0.0 = 1.0. Needs symbolic Float.exp 0.0 = 1.0, Float.mul_zero, Float.pow 1.0 x = 1.0 (all absent in core Lean).
entries.resolution: Backend Float transcendental semantics (Mathlib) or rational-model kappaExp; then replace sorry.

entries.name: kappaLog_one
entries.description: forall k, kappaLog k 1.0 = 0.0. Needs symbolic Float.pow 1.0 x = 1.0 (absent in core Lean). Intended domain: finite (non-NaN) k.
entries.resolution: Float.pow_one lemma in a Mathlib backend, then drop the universal claim or restrict the domain.

entries.name: kappa_entropy_additive
entries.description: forall SA SB, kappaEntropyCompose 0.0 SA SB = SA + SB. Needs symbolic Float ring identities (0.0*x=0.0, x+0.0=x) absent in core Lean. Formally false for SA/SB = NaN under IEEE equality; intended domain is finite floats. Concrete kernel witness exists: kappa_entropy_additive_witness (0.0/2.0/3.0 = 5.0, decide-proved).
entries.resolution: Add Float.zero_mul/add_zero lemmas (or Mathlib) and restrict domain to finite floats.

entries.name: energy_nonneg
entries.description: forall net, primeWeightedEnergy net >= 0. Needs symbolic Float ordering/division non-negativity of complex norms and prime reciprocals (absent in core Lean). Concrete kernel witness exists: energy_nonneg_witness (decide-proved 2-node instance).
entries.resolution: Float.add_nonneg/mul_nonneg/div_nonneg section in a Mathlib backend; then prove by induction over nodes.

entries.name: prime_coupling_bound
entries.description: >forall J pi pj, pi>=2 -> pj>=2 -> |J/(pi*pj)| <= |J|/4. Needs symbolic Float division monotonicity from Nat->Float (absent in core Lean). Concrete kernel witness exists: prime_coupling_bound_witness (decide-proved J=1, pi=2, pj=3).
entries.resolution: Float.div monotonicity + Float.ofNat_ofNat lemmas (Mathlib); then prove from prime_product_min and Float-ordered division.

entries.name: spectral_gap_positive
entries.description: forall J N, J>0 -> N>=2 -> spectralGapPrediction J N > 0. Needs symbolic Float ordering/reciprocation (absent in core Lean). Concrete kernel witness exists: spectral_gap_positive_witness (decide-proved N=10).
entries.resolution: Float.recip-mono + Float.positive-division section (Mathlib); then prove from primeSeq ordering.

entries.name: relaxation_time_finite
entries.description: forall gammaMin normA, gammaMin>0 -> gammaMin>normA -> relaxationTimePrediction gammaMin normA > 0. Needs symbolic Float ordering/division (absent in core Lean). Concrete kernel witness exists: relaxation_time_finite_witness (decide-proved).
entries.resolution: Float div-pos lemmas (Mathlib); then prove under the Float preorder section.

entries.name: lyapunov_nonneg
entries.description: forall V, h_energy: currentEnergy>=0 -> h_delay: delayIntegral>=0 -> lyapunovValue V >= 0. Soundness fix applied: original statement was missing the h_delay hypothesis (functional sums both components), making the claim false for negative delayIntegral. Still requires symbolic Float ordering/addition (absent in core Lean). Concrete kernel witness exists: lyapunov_nonneg_witness (decide-proved).
entries.resolution: Float.add_nonneg (Mathlib); then prove from the two hypotheses.

entries.name: stability_decreasing
entries.description: linearized stability margin: damping - couplingNorm*(1+delay) > 0 under stabilityCondition and isHurwitz. Symbolic Float arithmetic (ordering/mul/add) absent in core Lean. NOTE: this is the linearized margin, NOT the exact delay-EDF theorem. Concrete kernel witness exists: stability_decreasing_witness (decide-proved).
entries.resolution: Exact delay equation proof via a real-arithmetic backend; or downgrade to a documented approximation lemma.

entries.name: prime_stability_advantage
entries.description: forall J idx, primeCoupling J (primeSeq idx) (primeSeq idx) <= J/4. Needs symbolic Float division/ordering over primeSeq (absent in core Lean). Concrete kernel witness exists: prime_stability_advantage_witness (decide-proved).
entries.resolution: Compose prime_coupling_bound resolution with primeSeq >= 2 lemma; requires Float div-mono backend.

audit_note: Phase Mirror audit 2026-09-16: reconciled Kappa float-sorry debt per ADR-0010. 7 closed-literal theorems + 9 pairing witnesses kernel-proved via decide (axiom sweep verified {propext, Classical.choice, Quot.sound} only; zero sorryAx/native_decide-ax leaks). 13 symbolic Float theorems manifest-registered (Float.exp/pow/ordering opaque in core Lean, no Mathlib dep); all runtime-verified true. Removed stale entry (Core/phase_mirror_loop_scaffolds/invariant_gaps.lean does not exist in this tree). lyapunov_nonneg soundness-fixed (added required h_delay hypothesis). kappaExp_close_to_exp is true at runtime (4.5e-05 < 0.1) but requires a transcendental backend for a kernel proof. Pruned 55 paid-off legacy `permitted_sorrys` names (their declarations now carry real proofs or no longer exist in the Foundry build closure); `permitted_sorrys` now equals exactly the set of declarations currently hosting a sorry in scan scope (13).
